identitySignals: Agenda names 'UC Berkeley's EAOP'; the UC Berkeley site describes the Early Academic Outreach Program (EAOP), a college-access program run from UC Berkeley
EAOP's School Partners page lists Skyline High School under Oakland Unified School District, matching the agenda item (Skyline High School 2025-2026 Education Improvement Plan, Measures N and H)
EAOP's stated mission of college preparatory advising and academic enrichment matches OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' and College and Career Readiness Commission context
research.notes: University program (part of UC Berkeley Center for Educational Partnerships), not a separately registered entity, so no EIN, CA entity number or UEI. No main phone number listed on the site. Web search budget was exhausted; research used direct fetches of the program's own site only.

profile.address: 1 Hearst Field Annex, Building C50, Berkeley, CA 94720-1060
profile.summary: The Early Academic Outreach Program (EAOP) is a University of California, Berkeley program that works with schools and community organizations to prepare students from underserved communities for college. It offers college preparatory advising and academic enrichment opportunities. It serves students in Alameda and Contra Costa Counties.

review.notes: The agenda names 'UC Berkeley's EAOP' and the EAOP site lists Skyline High School as a partner school (the school page does not show the district, but Skyline is an Oakland high school and the item is a Skyline Measure N/H plan). Summary, website, generic office email, address and headquarters are confirmed on eaop.berkeley.edu and its contact page; the summary is neutral.
